chat.welcomeMessage: Work-management demo for a (fictional) Cape Cod water-quality & contaminated-sites program. The map, layers, map tools, cards and record editing are live in your browser; the AI chat replays a recorded session — pick the questions below in order.
starterQuestions: What's overdue across the program right now?
How is this month's sampling run going, by embayment?

Schedule annual AUL compliance inspections for every AUL site in Barnstable
